speaker: Raj
text: I have three words for you: wrath of Khan. I got the Mars rover stuck in a ditch.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh, thank God you're here. What's the emergency? Where? On the dusty highway just outside Bakersfield. Where do you think? On Mars?

speaker: Raj
text: Yeah, baby, I'll be right in.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You brought a girl to the Mars rover control room?

speaker: Raj
text: Yeah, I picked her up in the bar. She's a doctor. One free barium enema and my mother won't care. She's not Jewish.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Wait a minute, so the eye patch and the insults work?

speaker: Raj
text: No, there were three other guys with eye patches. It was a fiasco. What did work was, how do you like to visit a secret government facility?

speaker: Sheldon
text: So what exactly do you want us to do?

speaker: Raj
text: I need you and Raj to help me get the rover out of the ditch, and I need you to get Stephanie out before somebody notices she's here. She doesn't exactly have clearance. Really?

speaker: Sheldon
text: They don't let strange women from honky-tonks come in and play with two hundred million dollar government projects on distant planets?

speaker: Raj
text: Yes, I was bad. Maybe she'll spank me. Can we please move on?

speaker: Stephanie
text: Howard, is everything okay? Hey, Howard, you know it's getting late, so do I get to drive this thing or what?

speaker: Raj
text: Yeah, no, I'm sorry, but something's come up. Kind of a Mars rover. Mars rover. Can Howard come over?
